title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode19 Desire To Save

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Even if you're cursed, you still want to save me?
Hehe. It's brave of you to admit that.
But I already know listening to your song won't change anything. It might make me feel better for a while, but it would only end up strengthening my desire to disappear later.
So it doesn't matter anymore. Just leave me alone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yuki!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just knock it off already!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Enanan?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I came to give Yuki a piece of my mind!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All her talk of not being able to find herself and that it'd be better if she just disappeared really pisses me off!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's your problem?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How can you stand there with a straight face and say you'd rather disappear despite the fact that you have everything I've ever wanted?!
What are you talking about?
I have nothing. I never have.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm saying that's not the way I see it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have the ability to make such amazing songs!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you have all those people waiting for your next one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're so talented it makes me angry!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You have so much of what I want that... I...
I can't even stand it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't get your music out of my head! I hate selfish people like you so much, but I still can't help but want to listen to more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Even though I hate you, there's a part of me that doesn't want you to disappear. A part of me that wants to keep listening to your music!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, don't disappear...make more of it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you have talent, then for the sake of those who don't, keep writing! I won't forgive you if you just up and disappear now!
It doesn't matter whether or not my songs are any good.
What I want isn't great songs, nor is it the praise of others. All I wanted was to find what I was looking for.
But I now realize that it was all useless, so I no longer care.
Maybe you just don't understand that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yuki, you little—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So that's it. I kind of understand how Yuki feels.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Amia?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how smart or rich or cute someone is. Everyone goes through rough times, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even if Yuki can make amazing songs, they don't mean anything if she's not able to find whatever it is that she wants most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I think if she really wants to disappear, then she should be free to do so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can say as much as we want, but only Yuki can truly understand what she's going through.
In that case—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But still, I just sort of got the feeling we were somehow alike.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That part that feels like we might be able to change ourselves a bit at a time to fit in with those around us, and the confusion at whether we should resist or accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then getting so tired from trying so hard that nothing seems to matter anymore. I feel like we're similar in that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There aren't very many people who can understand how that feels.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that's why I think I'd feel really sad if you were to disappear now.
You're all so selfish.
Getting jealous, sympathizing with me, trying to save me when I didn't ask for help.
Just stop. Haven't you done enough?
I want to disappear. That is my only true feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if that's true, I still want to save you.
I can't take this anymore!
I'm tired of believing there's still a chance I can find what I'm looking for.
It would have been easier to believe I never could from the very beginning.
So...that's why...
I don't want to believe I can be saved anymore!
I'm tired! I look and I look and I look and I look!

But I just can't find it...
Then when I look again, it's just not right and I get depressed...
What am I even supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing.
Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this song isn't able to save you, I'll keep composing until I find the one that does.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.
What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this is a curse, I won't stop.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't bear the thought of another person disappearing right in front of me.
But... But...
Even you really want to disappear, don't you?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So if I ever get depressed and look like I might disappear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to tell me that you still haven't found what you're looking for.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you say that, I'll be able to continue composing forever.
Ridiculous.

Do you even realize what you're saying?
All you're doing is cursing yourself with another burden!
You're forcing yourself to keep composing songs until I'm able to find myself!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I know.
Why...would you go that far?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm just being selfish.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter which path I choose.
Either way, I have to keep composing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So doing this for you doesn't change a thing.
I just don't know...
I don't know how long it might take before I find myself. I may never be able to.
Even knowing that...you still want to do this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah.
Haha. You look so dumb, acting all desperate.
Hahaha... Haha...
Fine... I will try looking...a bit more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yuki...
You promise to keep writing music as long as it takes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ...Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay, Yuki. I promise I'll save you someday.
